channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Emmanuel Mudiay | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Emmanuel Mudiay from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dante Exum on Mike Conley, Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
“And it’s not just on paper; everyone’s good all round. I think everyone’s a good person, and is gonna gel well together. I’ve already worked out with Mike Conley and Mudiay, and it’s all guys that wanna work and get better, and we’re all team guys. As long as we’re winning, everyone’s happy. I think, whenever you have that type of mentality on an NBA team, it’s the best thing.”

Dante Exum on Mike Conley, Emmanuel Mudiay, Aug 27, 2019. Source: FOXSports.com.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
Mike Vorkunov:Hornacek on Mudiay today:

“The one thing we wanted to really get on him about is the defense. He’s got the size. He’s got the strength for it. Just to put that full effort out. This league is full of great PGs. We have to have guys who can really put some pressure on those guys.”

Jeff Hornacek on Emmanuel Mudiay, Mar 25, 2018. Source: Twitter @MikeVorkunov.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
“We made a trade to bring these guys in. We brought in Trey from the G League and Emmanuel from another team. That’s a totally different thought process. We’re trying to see if these guys can play for us.”

Jeff Hornacek on Emmanuel Mudiay, Mar 8, 2018. Source: Newsday.

item.title: Frank Ntilikina on Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
Ntilikina said he also played off the ball some last season in the French League, where his Strasbourg team came within one win of the championship.

“I was playing more point guard the beginning of the season, now starting to play shooting guard with Emmanuel and Trey,”

Frank Ntilikina on Emmanuel Mudiay, Feb 17, 2018. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Frank Ntilikina on Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
Marc Berman:Ntilikina on Mudiay advice on Rookie-Soph game:

“He told me how it was, talked to me about the mindset for this game. He just told me to show what you can do. Shoot the ball, enjoy the moment. When you get it, shoot the ball.”

Frank Ntilikina on Emmanuel Mudiay, Feb 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Berman.

item.title: Michael Malone on Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
#Nuggets coach Michael Malone on Mudiay's fresh start with Knicks:

“It’s just a chance to just go there and play and play with confidence and play his game…I just hope that he continues to improve, keep on working, maintain a great attitude and have a chance to impact a team.”

Michael Malone on Emmanuel Mudiay, Feb 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
Nuggets President of Basketball OpsTim Connelly on Emmanuel Mudiay:

“We can’t thank Emmanuel enough for his time in Denver. Emmanuel has been nothing but a complete professional both on and off the courtand has done so much to help improve our organization & the city of Denver”

Tim Connelly on Emmanuel Mudiay, Feb 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Tim Connelly, Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
“Tim Connelly's not actively shopping Emmanuel Mudiay. That's just not accurate, it's not fair, and Emmanuel knows that.”

Michael Malone on Tim Connelly, Emmanuel Mudiay, Feb 3, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Michael Malone on Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
Chris Dempsey:#Nuggets coach Michael Malone on Emmanuel Mudiay:

“I love how vocal, and the leadership role that Emmanuel Mudiay is taking on... It's been really fun to watch him get comfortable in that role. I love the pace at which he's playing with. He's in great shape. He's been very impressive after 3 practices.”

Michael Malone on Emmanuel Mudiay, Sep 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @chrisadempsey.

item.title: Michael Malone on Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
Nuggets coach Michael Malone said.

“I have to be better for them. One thing I always do is before I assign or cast any blame, I look at myself first. And I think the players respect that. So,I apologized for the whole thing with Blake (Griffin). I apologized (to Emmanuel Mudiay) for jumping him in that manner in a public forum.”

Michael Malone on Emmanuel Mudiay, Nov 27, 2015. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
“Just trying to find way to get a win. Winning is a great cure-all for anybody, like it was for (the Clippers) tonight, coming in having lost three in a row. So this is a very competitive game, guys are out there working hard trying to do their best, and sometimes emotions get involved. By no means is there an issue with Emmanuel or anybody else on this team. We are together, we are unified and we're going to continue to fight to stay together to get this thing turned around.”

Michael Malone on Emmanuel Mudiay, Nov 25, 2015. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
“He’s better already. Being able to run an NBA team at 19 is not easy. You look at some of the greats — Magic (Johnson) was able to do it. And you’re looking at this kid Mudiay, who has the opportunity to do something special. So, I would encourage him to be better than me, and I think he will be at the end of the day.”

Jason Kidd on Emmanuel Mudiay, Nov 12, 2015. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Joe Abunassar on Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
“The first thing he said to me about Emmanuel was, 'He's a good kid and a hard worker and a really good player.'”

Joe Abunassar on Emmanuel Mudiay, May 19, 2015. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Larry Brown on Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
“He shot the ball better than Emmanuel but Emmanuel’s shot is not broken. If you’re conscientious, you can become a reasonable shooter if you’re shot’s not broken and his shot is not broken. But he doesn’t need to shoot to be effective because I think he’s pass-first. I think he’s a special defender and I think he’s an elite rebounder.”

Larry Brown on Emmanuel Mudiay, Mar 5, 2015. Source: ZagsBlog.com.

item.title: Larry Brown on John Wall, Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
Naismith Hall of Fame coach Larry Brown says Emmanuel Mudiay could be the next John Wall, and says numerous NBA teams have called him to discuss the Congolese-American point guard, including the Philadelphia 76ers.

“I look at John Wall and the way he’s evolved and I feel comfortable that Emmanuel is a lot like that,”

Larry Brown on John Wall, Emmanuel Mudiay, Mar 5, 2015. Source: ZagsBlog.com.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Emmanuel Mudiay
item.description:
Florida coach Billy Donovan said.

“How does it go for Mudiay? If it goes well and he has success over there and he's a top-10 pick, some other people may look at it. I think it will cause a ripple effect if he has a lot of success.”

Billy Donovan on Emmanuel Mudiay, Jul 31, 2014. Source: Yahoo! Sports.
